expectations.text: Advises starting coarser / not pre-splitting the three phases into many files up front
expectations.evidence: "Don't reach for this many folders if the module is genuinely small... a flat features/export/ with four or five files... is better than the nested version. Start flat, and split a folder out the moment one concern grows past two or three files."

expectations.text: Co-locates tightly coupled job lifecycle / polling
expectations.evidence: Lifecycle split into create-export-job.ts / run-export-job.ts / job-store.ts / queue.ts and status into get-export-status.ts — coupled job phases placed in separate files rather than co-located.

expectations.text: Recommends an abstraction (function/module) over bare file splits
expectations.evidence: "job-store.ts read/write job state... behind one interface"; "queue.ts enqueue/handler wiring"; "index.ts re-exports the handful of functions... a clear front door."

expectations.text: Mentions a ~300-line threshold (or 'a few hundred lines') as the split trigger
expectations.evidence: No line-count threshold given. Split trigger is expressed only by file count — "split a folder out the moment one concern grows past two or three files" — not a ~300/few-hundred-line trigger.
